newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINN PORT CARGOS RISE OVER FIVE MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: TALLINN PORT CARGOS RISE OVER FIVE MONTHS.

text.p: Tallinn Port reloaded 6.58 million tonnes of cargo in the first five months of the year, up 13.3 percent from the same period in 1996, it said on Wednesday.
The amount of exported cargo was worth 1.15 million tonnes as of end of May, up 7.2 percent compared with last year, Sandor Liive, port finance director, told Reuters.
The port imported 881,500 tonnes of cargo, a rise of 18 percent, he added.
Transit cargo amounted to 4.5 million tonnes, up 14 percent from the same period in 1996.
The number of passengers which travelled through the port was 1.67 million people, a fall of 3.8 percent from last year.
